Please advise of the timing and sequencing for the signals at the intersection of Ocean Avenue and Junipero Serra Boulevard on November 24, 2024. Also, please advise if you received any reports of malfunctions in the signals at that location or nearby. If there are any costs involved please advise and we will promptly send a check to you.Thank you very much for your cooperation and attention to this matter.
